verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a hosted model API like Morph, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented way to choose a storage or processing region. The standby doc only says requests shed 429s 'when a region is busy', which implies multiple regions but gives no user control. Dedicated endpoints are chosen by model and plan, not by region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
